description: Fernwärmerohrleitungsnetz (Stadtwerke Göttingen AG) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. District heating is the term for a supply of heat for the supply of buildings with heating and hot water. The thermal energy is transported in a thermally insulated pipe system, which is mostly ground-mounted, but in some cases overhead lines are also used. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "District heating pipeline network (Stadtwerke Göttingen AG)" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
